## Highlights
### New
- On Mac, resting the pointer on a tab or pin in the sidebar shows a card beside it with the tab's title, its site and how its page last looked. Turn it off in Settings › Appearance › Preview hover. - On Mac, resting the pointer on a folder in the sidebar lists its tabs, including those in folders inside it, with a search field ready for typing. Open, unload or close a tab there, or drag it out of the folder, without opening the folder. Turn it off in Settings › Appearance › Preview hover. - On iPhone and iPad, holding a tab or pin in the sidebar shows its title, its site and how its page last looked above its menu, and holding a folder, or clicking it with a secondary click, opens a card with its tabs, a search field and the folder's menu behind "…". Hold and move to drag the folder instead. With a pointer on iPad, resting on a tab or folder shows its card beside the sidebar. Turn them off in Settings › Appearance › Previews.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
